basics.name: Giuseppe Santoro
basics.label: Senior Software Engineer
basics.summary: Senior Software Engineer with 12+ years developing high-scale distributed systems. Expert in full software lifecycle from code to production, specializing in cloud-native architectures, Kubernetes, and observability solutions. Proven track record supporting critical product launches at Elastic and PlayStation, with expertise spanning from Kubernetes development to high-performance analytics tools serving millions of users.

highlights: Developed synthetic monitoring framework using Playwright for Elastic Cloud Serverless launch, reducing production outages across 8+ engineering teams.
Served as Incident Commander resolving internal/external incidents while improving Elastic Synthetic monitoring product experience.
Implemented company-wide dependency management through Renovate, ensuring consistent software dependencies across codebases.
Built remote debugging solution for Elastic Beats on Kubernetes using Go Delve Debugger and Tilt.
Developed custom Elastic integration for Istio logs and metrics, enabling service mesh performance monitoring.
Created specialized dashboards for Elastic Kubernetes integration improving cluster visibility.
Resolved complex customer escalations for Kubernetes deployments while contributing bug fixes to Elastic codebases.
Built high-performance Golang analytics tool transforming query performance from minutes to seconds using AWS S3, Athena, and Glue.
Developed real-time event processor using AWS Lambda and Python for enhanced data correlation and insights.
Delivered end-to-end support for 10+ PlayStation game launches handling application development to AWS infrastructure.
Created Python video transcoding tool accelerating media content discovery for Studio Engineers.
Maintained reliable operations of 10+ microservices, 20+ EMR jobs, and 5+ Lambda functions in small team environment.
Optimized pipeline runtime using Google Dataflow to ingest 120M documents into Elasticsearch.
Migrated data pipeline from on-premise Hadoop to Google BigQuery improving query performance and cost efficiency.
Automated pipeline scheduling through Airflow on Kubernetes improving operational visibility.
Optimized Elasticsearch ingestion of 40M scientific publications by 8x (24 to 3 hours) using Spark multi-threading and S3 storage.
Automated pipeline scheduling using Python Airflow jobs.
Developed and maintained applications on Apache Mesos and Marathon (Kubernetes predecessors).
Delivered official Hortonworks Hadoop course at Hadoop Summit for 2 years plus 5+ private corporate courses with 90% positive feedback.
Led 3-engineer team in 4-month greenfield consulting project implementing complete client solution.
Achieved high certification scores on developer and administrator exams within months of self-study.
